title: RubyRushers
tagline: Sixty seconds, sixty-four gems, no mercy.
description: A fast match-three game on game-toolkit: a 60-second Rush with time gems, an Endless mode that ends when no move is left, and Tilt, where gravity turns a quarter every fifteen seconds. Written mainly so that its bot, which plays from screenshots alone, has something to play.

cover.alt: Rush mode mid-game: an 8×8 board of coloured gems with sparks, score popups, a bomb going off and time gems, next to a panel with the score and the clock.
